title: DECLARE PSALM 118 EVERY MORNING AND WATCH YOUR LIFE TURN AROUND
text: Glory, glory, glory to the most high God. Lift your hands right where you are. Don't wait for anyone. Don't look around. Just begin to worship. Begin to magnify the King of Kings. Begin to exalt the Lord of Lords. Something is about to shift in this atmosphere. I can feel it. The presence of God is already here. The spirit of the Lord is moving. Heaven is paying attention to this gathering. Father, we worship you. We bless your holy name. We magnify you above all things. You are the God who inhabits the praises of your people. You are the one who dwells in the midst of worship. Come, Lord. Come and have your way. Come and do what only you can do. Hallelujah. Before we go any further, I need you to do something. This message you're about to receive is not ordinary. This is a prophetic key that will unlock dimensions of transformation in your life. But it's not just for you. Somebody out there needs this word desperately. Share it. Send it to someone. Post it on your status. Let the word travel. God might use you as an instrument to change somebody's destiny today. Don't be selfish with revelation. Let it flow through you to others. Now lift your voice and worship. There is none like you, Lord. There is none like you. There is none like you, Lord. There is none like you. again with everything in you. There is none like you, Lord. There is none like you. There is none like you, Lord. There is none like you. You are holy. You are righteous. You are faithful. You are true. You are the alpha and the omega. You are the beginning and the end. You are the first and the last. You are the bright and morning star. We worship you, Father. We worship you all. Hail the power of Jesus name. Let angels prostrate for bring forth the royal diadem and crown him Lord of all. One more time. Bring forth the royal diadem and crown him Lord of all. Yes. Lord. Yes Lord. We crown you. We honor you. We enthrone you above every circumstance. We lift you higher than every situation. We magnify you beyond every challenge. Father, you are worthy. You are worthy of all of our praise. You are worthy of all of our adoration. You are worthy of everything we have and everything we are. We worship you. Somebody shout hallelujah. >> Hallelujah. Now listen to me very carefully. I'm about to share something with you that will transform your life if you receive it with faith and apply it with consistency. There is a psalm in the Bible. It is Psalm 118. Many people read it casually. Many people glance over it without understanding its power. But I'm telling you today, this psalm carries secrets that can revolutionize your existence. Let me read the first verse. Psalm 118:1 says, "Oh, give thanks unto the Lord for he is good because his mercy endureth forever." Did you hear that? His mercy endures forever. Not for a season, not for a moment, forever. But here's what many don't understand. This psalm is not just a collection of poetic verses. It's a prophetic weapon. It's a spiritual tool. It's a declaration system that activates heaven's response when spoken with faith. Look at what it says in verse 5 and six. I called upon the Lord in distress. The Lord answered me and set me in a large place. The Lord is on my side. I will not fear. What can man do unto me? The Psalmist was in distress. The Psalmist was surrounded by trouble. The Psalmist was facing opposition. But he called upon the Lord. He opened his mouth. He made a declaration and the Lord answered him and set him in a large place. This is the power of declaration. This is the mystery of the spoken word. This is the secret that many believers have missed. You see, prayer is not just asking God for things. Prayer includes declaration. Prayer includes proclamation. Prayer includes speaking the word of God over your life, over your circumstances, over your situations. The Bible says in Romans 10:17, "So then faith cometh by hearing and hearing by the word of God." When you speak the word, you hear the word. When you hear the word, faith is released. When faith is released, things begin to change. But notice the timing. The title of this message says, "Every morning," there's a reason for that. The morning is strategic. The morning is prophetic. The morning sets the tone for the entire day. Psalm 5:3 says, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up. David understood this. He knew that the morning was when you configure the day. The morning was when you establish spiritual jurisdiction. The morning was when you release your voice into the realm of the spirit and command your day to align with God's purposes. When you wake up in the morning and declare Psalm 118 over your life, you are not just reading words. You are activating promises. You are releasing power. You are establishing a spiritual foundation for the day. Let me show you something deeper. Look at Psalm 118:24. This is the day which the Lord hath made. We will rejoice and be glad in it. This verse is usually quoted casually. People say it as a greeting, but it's actually a declaration. It's a proclamation. is a prophetic statement that claims ownership of the day. When you say this is the day which the Lord have made, you are saying this day belongs to God. This day is under divine control. This day is not subject to accident or chance. This day IS DESIGNED BY THE ALMIGHTY. And then you add we will rejoice and be glad in it. You are not asking permission to be joyful. You are not hoping for happiness. You are declaring it. You are decreeing it. You are commanding your soul to align with the reality of God's goodness. This is powerful. Now, let me give you more revelation. Psalm 118 is structured in a way that covers every area of your life. It addresses enemies. It addresses victory. It addresses salvation. It addresses divine help. It addresses building and destiny. It addresses favor and blessing. When you declare this psalm every morning, you are covering every dimension of your existence with the word of God. Look at verses 10- 12. All nations compass me about, but in the name of the Lord will I destroy them. They compass me about, yeah, they compass me about, but in the name of the Lord, I will destroy them. They compass me about like bees. They are quenched as the fire of thorns. For in the name of the Lord, I will destroy them. Three times the psalmist says, "In the name of the Lord, I will destroy them." This is warfare language. This is combat declaration. This is victory proclamation. When you speak these words in the morning, you are not just reading poetry. You are engaging in spiritual warfare. You are declaring victory over every enemy that will surround you that day. You are prophesying your triumph before the battle even begins. This is how champions live. This is how overcomers operate. This is how victors function. They don't wait for the battle to come before they prepare. They prepare before the battle arrives. They declare before the conflict manifests. They prophesy before the storm appears. Proverbs 18:21 says, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof." Your tongue carries power. Your words create reality. Your declarations shape your future. When you wake up every morning and declare Psalm 118, you are using the power of your tongue to create the reality of victory, favor, and transformation in your life. Now, let me take you further into this psalm. Verse 17 says, "I shall not die but live and declare the works of the Lord." This is a declaration of life. This is a proclamation of survival. This is a prophecy of longevity. When you speak this verse over yourself every morning, you are commanding death to stay away from you. You are cancelling every assignment of premature termination. You are decreeing that you will live to fulfill your purpose, accomplish your assignment, and declare the works of the Lord. In a world where accidents happen, where sickness attacks, where danger locks, where the enemy seeks to kill, steal, and destroy, this declaration is essential. You need to open your mouth every morning and say, "I shall not die, but leave." And declare the works of the Lord. Say it with me right now. Open your mouth and say it. I shall not die but live and declare the works of the Lord. Again with more conviction. I shall not die but live and declare the works of the Lord. That's it. That's the declaration of life over your existence. Now look at verse 22 and 23. The stone which the builders refuse is become the headstone of the corner. This is the Lord's doing. It is marvelous in our eyes. This is one of the most powerful verses in the entire Bible. It speaks of rejection being overturned. It speaks of what was despised becoming celebrated. It speaks of what was dismissed becoming essential. Maybe you've been rejected. Maybe you've been overlooked. Maybe you've been passed over. Maybe people have refused you, dismissed you, written you off. But hear me, rejection is not final when God is involved. What men refuse, God can promote. What people reject, God can exalt. What builders refuse, God can make the headstone of the corner. When you declare this verse over your life every morning, you are prophesying your elevation. You are declaring your promotion. You are speaking your exaltation into existence. And notice what it says. This is the Lord's doing. It is marvelous in our eyes. When God promotes you, it will be marvelous. It will be extraordinary. It will be undeniable. People will not be able to explain it. They will only be able to acknowledge that it was the Lord's doing. Get ready for marvelous things. Get ready for extraordinary turnarounds. Get ready for supernatural elevations. Hallelujah. Let me give you more understanding about why the morning is so important. In the natural realm, the morning is when the sun rises. Is when light overcomes darkness. Is when a new day begins. is when opportunities are fresh in the spiritual realm. The morning is even more significant. It's when heaven's agenda for the day is being released. Is when assignments are being dispatched. Is when angels are receiving instructions. Is when the courts of heaven are active concerning the affairs of men. Mark 1:35 shows us that even Jesus understood this. And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed. If Jesus, the son of God, made morning prayer a priority, how much more should we? The morning is your point of advantage. The morning is your strategic position. The morning is your prophetic platform. When you declare Psalm 118 every morning, you are positioning yourself for transformation. You are aligning yourself with heaven's agenda, you are connecting yourself to divine flow. And here's the promise. Watch your life transform. Not maybe transform, not possibly transform. Watch it transform. Is a guarantee. Is a certainty. It's a prophetic promise. When you consistently declare God's word over your life, change is inevitable. Transformation is unavoidable. Breakthrough is certain. The Bible says in Isaiah 55 10-11, "For as the rain cometh down, and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but waterth the earth, and maketh it bring forth, and b that it may give seed to the swer, and bread to the eater. So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth. It shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it. God's word doesn't return void. God's word accomplishes its purpose. God's word prospers in its assignment. When you speak God's word, when you declare Psalm 118, that word goes to work. It begins to shift things. It begins to change things. It begins to transform things. You might not see it immediately. You might not feel it instantly, but the word is working. The word is moving. The word is accomplishing. Keep declaring. Keep speaking. Keep proclaiming. And watch your life transform. Now, I want to release this word into practical application. Let's pray. Let's declare. Let's prophesy. But first, understand what we're about to do. We're not just going through religious ritual. We're engaging in spiritual transaction. We're releasing words that carry power. We're making declarations that will shape reality. Are you ready? Stand to your feet. This is not a time to be casual. This is not a moment to be comfortable. This is warfare. This is engagement. This is confrontation with every force that has resisted your transformation. Lift your hands toward heaven. Open your mouth and begin to speak. Father, I thank you for this revelation. I thank you for the power of your word. I thank you for Psalm 118 and the keys it contains. Lord, I commit to declaring this psalm over my life every morning. I commit to speaking your word into my day. I commit to using my tongue to create the reality of victory, favor, and transformation. Now, begin to declare. I declare that the Lord is good. His mercy endures forever. His love never fails. His faithfulness never ends. I declare that when I call upon the Lord in distress, he answers me. He sets me in a large place. He gives me room to flourish. He creates space for my expansion. I declare that the Lord is on my side. I will not fear. What can man do unto me? What can enemies accomplish against me? What can opposition achieve against me? The Lord is my helper. I will see the defeat of those who hate me. I will witness the collapse of those who rise against me. I will observe the failure of those who plot against me. I declare that it is better to trust in the Lord than to put confidence in man. It is better to rely on God than to depend on princes. My trust is in the Lord. My confidence is in the almighty. My dependence is on the most high. Pray. Pray with fire. Pray with intensity. All nations compass me about every enemy, every opposition, every adversary, but in the name of the Lord, I will destroy them. They compass me about, they surrounded me. They encled me. They came against me from every direction, but in the name of the Lord, I will destroy them. They compass me about like beast, numerous, persistent, aggressive, but they are quenched as the fire of thorns. For in the name of the Lord, I will destroy them. I declare victory. I declare triumph. I declare conquest. No enemy will prevail against me. No adversary will succeed against me. No foe will prosper against me. The Lord is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. I will not die but live. I will not perish but survive. I will not be terminated but continue. I will live to declare the works of the Lord. I will live to testify of his goodness. I will live to proclaim his faithfulness. Death. Hear the word of the Lord. You have no right to my life. You have no claim on my existence. You have no authority over my days. I am preserved. I am protected. I am kept fire. Fire. I declare the gate of the Lord over my life. The righteous shall enter through it. I am righteous through the blood of Jesus. I qualify for entry. I have access to the gate. Every gate of blessing open unto me. Every gate of favor open unto me. Every gate of opportunity open unto me. Every gate of breakthrough open unto me. I am passing through. I am entering in. I am possessing what has been reserved for me. Now declare this. The stone which the builders refused has become the headstone of the corner. I have been rejected but I will be exalted. I have been refused but I will be celebrated. I have been overlooked but I will be promoted. This is the Lord's doing and it is marvelous. My promotion is God's work. My elevation is heaven's agenda. My exaltation is divine design. I receive marvelous turnarounds. I receive extraordinary reversals. I receive supernatural transformations. What was meant to destroy me will position me. What was designed to diminish me will enlarge me. What was intended to end me will establish me. Hallelujah. Now, let's go deeper. Let's pray specifically for every area of your life. Lift your hands and pray for your destiny. Father, I bring my destiny before you this morning. I declare Psalm 118 over my destiny. My destiny will not be aborted. My destiny will not be hijacked. My destiny will not be manipulated. I will fulfill the purpose for which I was created. I will accomplish the assignment for which I was sent. I will complete the mission for which I was designed. Every attack against my destiny, I neutralize it now in the name of Jesus. Every force working against my purpose, I bind it now in the name of Jesus. Every power manipulating my calling, I destroy it now in the name of Jesus. The Lord is on my side concerning my destiny, I will not fear. What can any power do unto me? My destiny is preserved. My purpose is protected. My calling is secured. I shall not die before fulfilling my destiny. I shall live and declare the works of the Lord through the accomplishment of my assignment. The stone which destiny killers refused will become the headstone of the corner. What was meant to abort my destiny will be the platform for my manifestation in the name of Jesus. Now pray for your family. Pray for your household. Father, I cover my family with the word of Psalm 118. I declare transformation over my household. Every member of my family is blessed. My parents are blessed. My spouse is blessed. My children are blessed. My siblings are blessed. My extended family is blessed. The mercy of the Lord endures forever over my family line. His goodness continues from generation to generation. His faithfulness extends to my children's children. Every curse operating in my family, I break it now. Every negative pattern repeating in my lineage, I terminate it now. Every evil inheritance passing through my bloodline, I cancel it now. My family will serve the Lord. My household will honor God. My lineage will glorify the Almighty. I declare that as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord. This is non-negotiable. This is settled. This is established. Salvation visits my family. Deliverance comes to my household. Transformation touches my lineage. Every unsaved family member, I speak to their hearts. Let the light of the gospel shine upon them. Let the truth of God's word penetrate their minds. Let the love of Christ draw them to repentance. Before this season is over, I will have testimonies concerning my family. I will see changed lives. I will witness transformed hearts. I will observe delivered souls in the name of Jesus. Fire upon my family. Fire upon my household. Fire upon my lineage. Let every ancestral power lose its grip. Let every generational bondage be broken. Let every inherited cause be canled. My family is free. My household is liberated. My lineage works in liberty in Jesus mighty name. Now let's pray for marriages. Whether you're married, believing for marriage or struggling in marriage, this prayer is for you. Father, I bring marriages before you. I declare Psalm 118 over the institution of marriage. For those who are married, I speak peace into your homes. I speak love into your relationships. I speak unity into your unions. The Lord is on the side of your marriage. You will not fear divorce. You will not fear separation. You will not fear destruction. What God has joined together, no man, no demon, no circumstance, no challenge will put us under. I break the power of marital conflict. I break the power of misunderstanding. I break the power of unforgiveness. I break the power of bitterness. Let love flow again. Let communication be restored. Let intimacy be renewed. Let partnership be strengthened. Every third party interfering in marriages be exposed and expelled. Every external influence working against unions be identified and removed. Every demonic assignment against homes be cancelled and destroyed. I declare that marriages will not just survive, they will thrive. Couples will not just stay together, they will grow together. Homes will not just exist, they will flourish. For those believing God for marriage, hear me, the Lord is good. His mercy endures forever over your marital destiny. You will not grow old alone. You will not be forgotten. You will not be passed over. The right person is being prepared. The right time is being arranged. The right connection is being orchestrated. I break every course of delayed marriage. I break every spell of marital frustration. I break every enchantment of prolonged singleness. The stone which the builders refused will become the headstone of the corner. You who have been overlooked will be celebrated. You who have been passed over will be chosen. You who have been rejected will be embraced. Your wedding day is coming. Your spouse is on the way. Your home is being prepared. This is the day the Lord has made concerning your marital destiny. Rejoice and be glad in it in the name of Jesus. Now, let's address finances. Let's pray for economic transformation. Father, I bring finances before you. I declare Psalm 118 over my financial life. The Lord is good. His mercy endures forever over my finances. His goodness extends to my economic situation. His faithfulness covers my financial needs. I declare that I will not lack. I will not beg. I will not borrow without ability to repay. The Lord is my helper in finances. I will see the defeat of poverty. I will witness the collapse of lack. I will observe the failure of scarcity. I decree that money will come to me this week. Resources will flow toward me. Opportunities for increase will find me. Every financial door that has been shut open now. Every economic gate that has been locked be broken now. Every monetary barrier that has been erected collapsed now. I call forth contracts. I call forth deals. I call forth agreements. I call forth settlements. I call forth payments. I call forth profits. The stone which the builders refused will become the headstone of the corner. Opportunities that were denied will be granted. Deals that were rejected will be approved. Contracts that were refused will be signed. This is the Lord's doing. My financial transformation is heaven's agenda. My economic breakthrough is divine design. I will lend and not borrow. I will give and not beg. I will finance kingdom projects. I will support the work of God. I will be a channel of blessing to others. Poverty, hear the word of the Lord. Your assignment over my life is terminated. I am moving from lack to abundance. From scarcity to surplus, from barely enough to more than enough in the name of Jesus. Fire upon my finances, fire upon my economic life, fire upon my monetary situation. Let the windows of heaven open. Let the blessings pour down. Let the abundance flow. I receive financial transformation. I receive economic breakthrough. I receive monetary miracles in Jesus mighty name. Now, let's pray for health. Let's declare healing over your body. Father, I bring my body before you. I declare Psalm 118 over my health. I shall not die but live and declare the works of the Lord. This is my declaration. This is my proclamation. This is my confession. My body is the temple of the Holy Spirit. Sickness has no place in me. Disease has no right to stay. Infirmity has no authority over my flesh. I command every cell in my body to function according to divine design. I command every organ to operate at optimal capacity. I command every system to work in perfect harmony. The Lord is my helper in health. I will see the defeat of disease. I will witness the collapse of sickness. I will observe the failure of infirmity. If there is any abnormality in my body, I command it to be corrected now. If there is any malfunction, I command it to be repaired now. If there is any disease hiding in my flesh, I command it to die now. I speak to cancer, you cannot stay. I speak to diabetes, you must go. I speak to high blood pressure, you are defeated. I speak to arthritis, you are destroyed. I speak to every sickness by name. You have no place in my body. The mercy of the Lord endures forever over my health. His goodness covers my physical well-being. His faithfulness extends to every part of my body. I will walk in divine health. I will operate in supernatural vitality. I will function with heavenly strength. This is the day the Lord has made. I will rejoice and be glad in it with a healthy body, a sound mind, and a vibrant spirit in the name of Jesus. I'm sensing something in the spirit. Someone listening right now has been battling a condition that doctors have called chronic. They've said you have to manage it for the rest of your life. They've said there's no cure. But the Lord is saying to you, what medicine cannot do, my power will accomplish. What science has declared incurable, my miracle will heal this season. Something is shifting in your body, the healing power of God is touching you right now. Receive it. Receive it by faith. Don't look at the symptoms. Don't focus on the diagnosis. Look at the one who created your body. Trust the one who designed your organs. Believe the one who formed your cells. You are healed. YOU ARE WHOLE. YOU ARE RESTORED. FATHER, I release healing power into this body right now. Let the virtue of Christ flow. Let the anointing bring restoration. Let the fire of God consume every sickness in Jesus mighty name. Hallelujah. Now let's deal with evil covenants and curses. This is important. Many believers don't realize that there are spiritual agreements that affect their lives. Covenants that ancestors made. Courses that were spoken over family lines. Dedications that were done without consent. But Psalm 118 gives us a key. It says, "The Lord is on my side. When the Lord is on your side, no covenant against you can stand. No cause against you can prosper. No dedication against you can hold." Galatians 3:3 says, "Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a cost for us. For it is written, cost is everyone that hangeth on a tree. You have been redeemed. The price has been paid. The blood has been shed. Lift your voice and pray. In the name of Jesus Christ, I disconnect myself from every evil covenant made by my ancestors. I did not sign it. I renounce every dedication made concerning my life. I renounce every blood sacrifice offered using my name or identity. The blood of Jesus speaks better things. The blood of Jesus cancels every ungodly agreement. The blood of Jesus nullifies every demonic contract, I am free. My children are free. My lineage is free. Every curse operating in my life, I break it now. Every spoken word of destruction released against me, I cancel it now. Every enchantment placed upon my head, I destroy it now. The stone which the pew has refused has become the headstone of the corner. What was meant to cost me will become my blessing. What was designed to destroy me will become my platform. I am not cursed. I am blessed. I am not bound. I am free. I am not limited. I am liberated from today. I walk in blessing not cursing. I walk in favor not disfavor. I walk in progress not retrogression. In the name of Jesus fire, fire. Now hear me as I bring this to a close. Receive this prophetic seal over your life. I have shared with you a mystery today. Psalm 118 is not just scripture. It is a weapon. It is a key. It is a tool for transformation. When you declare it every morning, you are not performing ritual. You are releasing power. You are activating promises. You are commanding your day to align with heaven's agenda. From this day forward, let Psalm 118 be on your lips every morning. Before you check your phone, before you read the news, before you step out of your house, open your mouth and declare it and watch your life transform. Watch things begin to shift. Watch doors begin to open. Watch enemies begin to scatter. Watch favor begin to manifest. Now, receive this final declaration over your life. The siege is over. The limitation is broken. The stagnation is terminated. You are moving forward. You are rising higher. You are going further than you've ever gone before. The stone which the builders refused, that's you, is now becoming the headstone of the corner. Your season of rejection is over. Your time of celebration has begun. This is the Lord's doing. It is marvelous. It cannot be explained by human logic. It can only be attributed to divine intervention. I decree over your life transformation is your portion. Miracles are your inheritance. Breakthrough is your destiny. Every morning you open your mouth to declare Psalm 118, heaven will respond. Angels will move. Circumstances will shift. Enemies will scatter. Favor will manifest. You shall not die but leave. You will declare the works of the Lord. You will testify of his goodness. You will proclaim his faithfulness. Walk into this new season with boldness. Walk with authority. Walk with confidence. The Lord is on your side. You will not fear. You will see the defeat of everything that has stood against you. Shabaandala. Fire. Fire. Fire. I seal this word with the blood of Jesus. I seal your transformation with prophetic authority. I seal your breakthrough with divine guarantee. It is done. It is finished. It is settled. Go and declare Psalm 118 every morning and watch watch your life transform before your very eyes. The grace to be consistent is released upon you now. The discipline to be faithful is imparted to you now. The fire to continue is ignited in you now. You will not forget this word. You will not neglect this instruction. You will act on it and you will testify in the mighty, matchless, marvelous name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. Somebody shout a victorious amen. Amen. Go in power. Go in victory. Go in transformation. The Lord is with you. Hallelujah.
